what_changed: Marvell and Lumentum signed an all-stock merger on 2026-11-01 (announced 11-02): 4.500 MRVL per LITE share, ~$1,132 per share and 23.9% premium on 10-28 undisturbed prices, >$1B run-rate cost synergies (primarily COGS), close 1H CY2028, $3.2B regulatory reverse fee.
